_comment: GA-CORE golden values. Node and the instance's Rhino jar must both produce exactly these (ga-core-node, ga-core-golden-rhino, ga-core-replay). Regenerate only for a deliberate change to the GA core, with: node tools/genome/test/golden.js and node tools/genome/test/replay_golden.js, and say why in the commit. Last change: save().base values carry the LRU rank as a fifth integer (liveFinal and replay hash the whole save; every event stream and every other digest is unchanged).
